title: Some Dungeons Artifacts
description: This datapack adds some of the Artifacts from Minecraft's Spin-Off, Minecraft Dungeons
body:
A datapack that adds some of MC Dungeons Artifacts
- 
**Note: This pack recommends heavily using the resource pack for it because its the only way of telling the artifacts appart, you can find the resource pack in the supplementary resource**

Did you enjoy the Artifacts that MC Dungeons gave to the game?

Well if you did, this datapack might be for you, This datapack adds
11 Unique Artifacts for you to use, this not only adds the artifacts but it also helps with some of minecraft's exploration issues aswell because the artifacts are found in different structures so you have to explore more to get them :)

Now, how do this Artifacts work, To make it more similar to the Dungeons mechanic, I divided the Artifacts into 3 Classes:

**Defense, Movility, Attack**

To explain it easy, Every Artifact that is on the same class will share cooldown, What does it mean?, let's say you have to artifacts with the Movility class, and if you were to use one, both of them would enter on cooldown, so you wouldn't be able to use any of them until the cooldown is over, is quite easy to understand once you play it!, but now, What Artifacts do we have?, And what do they do?, Bellow ill explain what every artifact does and how to obtain it!

The Artifacts
- 

<details>
<summary>Artifacts</summary>

![Boots of Swiftness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa0f1a5c00b0452b4ee6ce034ae479191e1dc84d.png)

**Boots of Swiftness**

Class: Movility

When using the boots of swiftness you'll get speed 2 for 3 seconds
and has a cooldown of 8 seconds, and can be found at dungeons(Spawner rooms) 

![Totem of regeneration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5cfa5ba75a41c5072ed59d26b57babf313079d3e.png)

**Totem of Regeneration**

Class: Defense

When using the totem of regeneration you and players close to you will recieve the effect of Regeneration 2 for 10 seconds and has a cooldown of 35 seconds, and can be found at Pillager Outposts

![Updraft Tome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a057525248ed1af73e8022b37f4b49cf73c0825d.png)

**Updraft Tome**

Class: Attack

When you use this tome, it wild throw nearest mobs(max: 5 mobs) into the air and recieve more damage, has a cooldown of 35 seconds and can be found at the stronghold library

![Iron Hide Amulet](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/55e9ffd8c0be2e67d2b8c00c97e471c68d3b07f7.png)

**Iron Hide Amulet**

Class: Attack

When using this amulet it will grant you resistance 2 for 8 seconds, has a cooldown of 35 seconds, and can be found at Weaponsmith houses on villages

![Ghost Cloak](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dc66b297fe0e425e736b9473c1fa49e21ce9f3e3.png)

**Ghost Cloak**

Class: Movility

When using this cloak, you will gain invisibility for 5 seconds and speed 1 for 3 seconds, it has a cooldown of 12 seconds and can be found at end cities 

![death cap mushroom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a877e216176f03f301a113b10dbf1a9cb82b9cf.png)

**Death Cap Mushroom**

Class: Attack

When you eat this mushroom, you will get a boost in speed, attack speed, and get strength for a couple of seconds, it has a cooldown of 45 seconds and can be found at end cities

![Corrupt seeds](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/48dd4b681f13f41b2bfe4a60230880eb0db19496.png)

**Corrupt Seeds**

Class: Attack

When using the corrupt seeds you will poison mobs around you for 8 seconds(max: 8 mobs), it has a cooldown of 40 seconds and can be found at jungle temples

![lightning rod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7e3cf831b247ab16d4a1e468fdc16697058e7af6.png)

**Lightning rod**

Class: Attack 

When using this Lightning rod a powerfull lightning will strike the nearest mob and do great damage, it has a cooldown of 30 seconds, and can be found at woodland mansions

![Gong of Weakness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b07b202adc342186ef8700b33f5ff579cf8c464.png)

**Gong of Weakness**

Class: Attack

When using this gong you will provoke weakness on nearby mobs(max: 8 mobs), has a cooldown of 35 seconds and can be found at trial chambers on ominous vaults

![Corrupted Beacon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/789529bd64165a7467f97d18e762fe440c985977.png)

**Corrupted Beacon**

Class: Attack

When using the corrupted beacon, you will fire a deadly laser at enemies doing constant damage for 12 seconds, it has a cooldown of 45 seconds and can be found at end cities

![Harvester](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c30530bf5d08fa0266dae9cd60c68338d49b671b.png)

**Harvester**

Class: Attack

When using the Harvester, you will release a big amount of souls, making a powerfull explosion causing big damage to enemies around you, it has a cooldown of 45 seconds and can be found at ancient cities

![Venom Quiver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/96a125a1e36357f723c0ec8eb18787bb66e7c9ac.png)

**Venom Quiver**

Class: Attack

When using the venom quiver, you will get 5 poison arrows, it has a cooldown of 35 seconds and can be found at desert temples

![Ice Quiver](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb91fbaa6b2fb1cbaf914df86d40a76a8f541ec4.png)

**Ice Quiver**

Class: Attack

When using the ice quiver, you will get 15 slowness arrows, it has a cooldown of 35 seconds and can be found at ancient cities, specifically the ice room 

</details>
